datasets.name: usage_kpis
queryLines:
WITH usage_base AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        CAST(u.usage_date AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product='GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit='DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12)
)
SELECT
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)
  THEN user_identity END) AS identities_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN dbus ELSE 0D END),2) AS dbus_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN free_dbus ELSE 0D END),2) AS free_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN billed_dbus ELSE 0D END),2) AS billed_dbus_30d,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN workspace_id END) AS workspaces_30d,
 MAX(usage_date) AS latest_usage_date
FROM usage_base

datasets.name: usage_monthly
queryLines:
WITH usage_base AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        CAST(u.usage_date AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product='GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit='DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12)
)
, months AS (
 SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12), CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS month_start
), monthly AS (
 SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',usage_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  SUM(dbus) AS dbus, SUM(free_dbus) AS free_dbus, SUM(billed_dbus) AS billed_dbus,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity) AS active_identities
 FROM usage_base GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',usage_date) AS DATE)
), filled AS (
 SELECT m.month_start,
  COALESCE(x.dbus,0D) AS dbus, COALESCE(x.free_dbus,0D) AS free_dbus,
  COALESCE(x.billed_dbus,0D) AS billed_dbus,
  COALESCE(x.active_identities,0) AS active_identities
 FROM months m LEFT JOIN monthly x ON m.month_start=x.month_start
), compared AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(dbus) OVER(ORDER BY month_start) AS prior_dbus,
  LAG(active_identities) OVER(ORDER BY month_start) AS prior_identities
 FROM filled
)
SELECT month_start AS month,
 DATE_FORMAT(month_start,'yyyy-MM') AS month_key,
 CASE WHEN month_start=CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE) THEN 'CURRENT_PARTIAL' ELSE 'COMPLETE' END AS month_status,
 ROUND(dbus,2) AS total_dbus, ROUND(free_dbus,2) AS free_dbus,
 ROUND(billed_dbus,2) AS billed_dbus, active_identities,
 CASE WHEN month_start=CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE) OR prior_dbus IS NULL OR prior_dbus<=0D THEN NULL
      ELSE ROUND(dbus/prior_dbus-1D,4) END AS mom_dbu_change,
 CASE WHEN month_start=CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE) OR prior_identities IS NULL OR prior_identities<=0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ROUND(active_identities*1D/prior_identities-1D,4) END AS mom_identity_change
FROM compared ORDER BY month

datasets.name: product_monthly
queryLines:
WITH usage_base AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        CAST(u.usage_date AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product='GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit='DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12)
)
, months AS (
 SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12), CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS month_start
), products AS (
 SELECT product FROM VALUES ('GENIE_CODE'),('GENIE_ONE'),('GENIE_AGENTS') AS v(product)
), agg AS (
 SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',usage_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
   genie_product, SUM(dbus) AS total_dbus, SUM(free_dbus) AS free_dbus,
   SUM(billed_dbus) AS billed_dbus,COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity) AS identities
 FROM usage_base GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',usage_date) AS DATE),genie_product
)
SELECT m.month_start AS month, DATE_FORMAT(m.month_start,'yyyy-MM') AS month_key,
 p.product AS genie_product,
 ROUND(COALESCE(a.total_dbus,0D),2) AS total_dbus,
 ROUND(COALESCE(a.free_dbus,0D),2) AS free_dbus,
 ROUND(COALESCE(a.billed_dbus,0D),2) AS billed_dbus,
 COALESCE(a.identities,0) AS active_identities
FROM months m CROSS JOIN products p
LEFT JOIN agg a ON m.month_start=a.month_start AND p.product=a.genie_product
ORDER BY month,genie_product

datasets.name: user_signals
queryLines:
WITH usage_base AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        CAST(u.usage_date AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product='GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit='DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12)
)
, summarized AS (
 SELECT user_identity,
  SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN dbus ELSE 0D END) AS dbus_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN billed_dbus ELSE 0D END) AS billed_dbus_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),59) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),30) THEN dbus ELSE 0D END) AS prior_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),6) THEN dbus ELSE 0D END) AS last_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),34) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),7) THEN dbus ELSE 0D END) AS prior_28d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN usage_date END) AS activity_days_30d,
  MIN(usage_date) AS first_metered_date, MAX(usage_date) AS last_metered_date
 FROM usage_base GROUP BY user_identity
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *,DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY dbus_30d DESC) AS consumption_rank,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY billed_dbus_30d DESC) AS billed_rank,
  CASE WHEN prior_28d>0D THEN ROUND((last_7d/7D)/(prior_28d/28D),2) END AS weekly_rate_ratio
 FROM summarized
), classified AS (
 SELECT *, CASE
   WHEN billed_dbus_30d>0D AND billed_rank<=5 THEN 'High billed'
   WHEN consumption_rank<=5 AND dbus_30d>0D THEN 'Power user'
   WHEN last_7d>=15D AND weekly_rate_ratio>=3D THEN 'Rising fast'
   WHEN dbus_30d=0D AND prior_30d>0D THEN 'Dormant'
   WHEN dbus_30d>0D AND first_metered_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN 'Newly active'
   ELSE 'Regular' END AS user_signal
 FROM ranked
)
SELECT user_identity,user_signal,consumption_rank,
 ROUND(dbus_30d,2) AS dbus_30d, ROUND(billed_dbus_30d,2) AS billed_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(prior_30d,2) AS prior_30d, ROUND(last_7d,2) AS last_7d_dbus,
 ROUND(prior_28d,2) AS prior_28d_dbus, weekly_rate_ratio,
 activity_days_30d,first_metered_date,last_metered_date
FROM classified
WHERE dbus_30d>0D OR prior_30d>0D
ORDER BY CASE user_signal
 WHEN 'High billed' THEN 1 WHEN 'Power user' THEN 2
 WHEN 'Rising fast' THEN 3 WHEN 'Dormant' THEN 4
 WHEN 'Newly active' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END,
 billed_dbus_30d DESC,dbus_30d DESC

datasets.name: cost_kpis
queryLines:
WITH joined AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        u.record_id, CAST(u.usage_date AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as,'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface,'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name, CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) END AS billed_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D
             WHEN lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN NULL
             ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE) END AS priced_usd,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' AND lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY u.account_id,u.record_id
           ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST) AS price_rn
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
 ON u.sku_name=lp.sku_name AND u.cloud=lp.cloud AND u.usage_unit=lp.usage_unit
 AND u.usage_end_time>=lp.price_start_time
 AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time<lp.price_end_time)
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product='GENIE'
 AND u.usage_unit='DBU'
 AND u.usage_date >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12)
), base AS (SELECT * FROM joined WHERE price_rn=1)
, user_cost AS (
 SELECT user_identity, SUM(COALESCE(priced_usd,0D)) AS user_usd
 FROM base WHERE usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) GROUP BY user_identity
), ranked_cost AS (
 SELECT user_identity,user_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY user_usd DESC) AS rn
 FROM user_cost
), concentration AS (
 SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=5 THEN user_usd ELSE 0D END)*1D /
 NULLIF(SUM(user_usd),0D),4) AS top5_cost_share
 FROM ranked_cost
), totals AS (
 SELECT
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN missing_price ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced_30d,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN COALESCE(priced_usd,0D) ELSE 0D END) AS usd_30d,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE) THEN missing_price ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced_mtd,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE) THEN COALESCE(priced_usd,0D) ELSE 0D END) AS usd_mtd,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE),-1) AND usage_date<CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE) THEN missing_price ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced_last_month,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE),-1) AND usage_date<CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE) THEN COALESCE(priced_usd,0D) ELSE 0D END) AS usd_last_month,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE),-2) AND usage_date<ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE),-1) THEN missing_price ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced_prior_month,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date>=ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE),-2) AND usage_date<ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE),-1) THEN COALESCE(priced_usd,0D) ELSE 0D END) AS usd_prior_month
 FROM base
)
SELECT CASE WHEN unpriced_30d>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(usd_30d,2) END AS estimated_cost_30d,
 CASE WHEN unpriced_mtd>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(usd_mtd,2) END AS estimated_cost_mtd,
 CASE WHEN unpriced_mtd>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(usd_mtd*DAY(LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE()))/GREATEST(DAY(CURRENT_DATE()),1),2) END AS projected_month_end_usd,
 CASE WHEN unpriced_last_month>0 OR unpriced_prior_month>0 OR usd_prior_month<=0D
 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(usd_last_month/usd_prior_month-1D,4) END AS last_complete_month_mom_cost_change,
 CASE WHEN unpriced_30d>0 THEN NULL ELSE top5_cost_share END AS top5_cost_share,
 unpriced_30d AS unpriced_paid_records_30d,unpriced_mtd AS unpriced_paid_records_mtd
FROM totals CROSS JOIN concentration

datasets.name: cost_monthly
queryLines:
WITH joined AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        u.record_id, CAST(u.usage_date AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as,'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface,'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name, CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) END AS billed_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D
             WHEN lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN NULL
             ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE) END AS priced_usd,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' AND lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY u.account_id,u.record_id
           ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST) AS price_rn
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
 ON u.sku_name=lp.sku_name AND u.cloud=lp.cloud AND u.usage_unit=lp.usage_unit
 AND u.usage_end_time>=lp.price_start_time
 AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time<lp.price_end_time)
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product='GENIE'
 AND u.usage_unit='DBU'
 AND u.usage_date >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12)
), base AS (SELECT * FROM joined WHERE price_rn=1)
, months AS (
 SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12),CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE),INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS month_start
), agg AS (
 SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',usage_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  SUM(COALESCE(priced_usd,0D)) AS priced_usd, SUM(missing_price) AS missing_price
 FROM base GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',usage_date) AS DATE)
), filled AS (
 SELECT m.month_start,COALESCE(a.priced_usd,0D) AS amount,
 COALESCE(a.missing_price,0) AS missing_price FROM months m
 LEFT JOIN agg a ON m.month_start=a.month_start
), compared AS (
 SELECT *,LAG(amount) OVER(ORDER BY month_start) AS prior_amount,
 LAG(missing_price) OVER(ORDER BY month_start) AS prior_missing FROM filled
)
SELECT month_start AS month,DATE_FORMAT(month_start,'yyyy-MM') AS month_key,
 CASE WHEN month_start=CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE) THEN 'CURRENT_PARTIAL' ELSE 'COMPLETE' END AS month_status,
 CASE WHEN missing_price>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(amount,2) END AS estimated_cost_usd,
 missing_price AS unpriced_paid_records,
 CASE WHEN month_start=CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE) OR missing_price>0 OR COALESCE(prior_missing,0)>0
 OR prior_amount IS NULL OR prior_amount<=0D THEN NULL
 ELSE ROUND(amount/prior_amount-1D,4) END AS mom_cost_change
FROM compared ORDER BY month

datasets.name: cost_users
queryLines:
WITH joined AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        u.record_id, CAST(u.usage_date AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as,'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface,'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name, CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) END AS billed_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D
             WHEN lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN NULL
             ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE) END AS priced_usd,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' AND lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY u.account_id,u.record_id
           ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST) AS price_rn
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
 ON u.sku_name=lp.sku_name AND u.cloud=lp.cloud AND u.usage_unit=lp.usage_unit
 AND u.usage_end_time>=lp.price_start_time
 AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time<lp.price_end_time)
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product='GENIE'
 AND u.usage_unit='DBU'
 AND u.usage_date >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12)
), base AS (SELECT * FROM joined WHERE price_rn=1)
, result AS (
 SELECT user_identity,ROUND(SUM(billed_dbus),2) AS billed_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(dbus),2) AS total_dbus_30d,
 SUM(COALESCE(priced_usd,0D)) AS amount_usd,
 SUM(missing_price) AS unpriced_paid_rows
 FROM base WHERE usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)
 GROUP BY user_identity
)
SELECT user_identity,total_dbus_30d,billed_dbus_30d,
 CASE WHEN unpriced_paid_rows>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(amount_usd,2) END AS estimated_cost_usd,
 unpriced_paid_rows
FROM result ORDER BY estimated_cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST,billed_dbus_30d DESC,total_dbus_30d DESC LIMIT 50

datasets.name: workspace_coverage
queryLines:
WITH usage_base AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        CAST(u.usage_date AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product='GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit='DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE), -12)
)
SELECT account_id, workspace_id,
 COUNT(*) AS usage_records_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity) AS identities_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(dbus),2) AS dbus_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(free_dbus),2) AS free_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(billed_dbus),2) AS billed_dbus_30d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN user_identity='unattributed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unattributed_rows_30d,
 MAX(usage_date) AS last_metered_date
FROM usage_base WHERE usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)
GROUP BY account_id,workspace_id ORDER BY dbus_30d DESC
